newsitem.title: USA: Continental jet makes emergency landing in Houston.
newsitem.headline: Continental jet makes emergency landing in Houston.

text.p: A Continental Airlines 727 with 85 passengers and six crewmembers made an emergency landing Tuesday at Houston Intercontinental Airport after a hydraulic system apparently malfunctioned, an airline spokeswoman said.
Continental Flight 754 bound for Newark, N.J., reported the hydraulic system failure shortly after take-off from the Houston airport, Continental spokeswoman Karla Villalon said.
The plane landed safely after jettisoning its fuel and circling the airport while fire trucks and emergency vehicles were positioned along the runway.
Smoke could be seen trailing the plane as it touched down, but there was no fire and no one was injured, she said.
